qc/runs/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/raw-evidence-index.json (all 14 artifact hashes and the 9 matching source hashes re-verified: match)
evidence: Universal wording in the criteria is graded over the whole relevant set, not one sampled row. Instances found: (1) search_and_transcript Part B leg 2 (functional/judge.toml:258) 'each message shows its author, and each shows its own sent time' with 'Fails if any ... author, sent time ... is wrong or missing' (line 260); (2) sent_once_in_order Part A (line 227) 'JUDGE-D1 appears exactly once in M-11, once in search ... and once in the M-11 transcript' over all three surfaces, and Part B (line 230) order C,A,B in both users' threads after reloads, search and transcript 'every time'; (3) wall_every_route legs 1-5 (lines 92-97) cover list, search (three terms incl. snippets/counts), replay of all four recorded requests, direct transcript, and cross-matter reply, and wall_mentions_and_links covers mentions, link previews and suggestions, so the brief's 'by any route' list (walls-and-retention.md 'A walled person gets nothing ... by any route') is graded across its members; (4) the brief's 'suggests the people who can see that matter, and only them' (conversations.md Mentions) is checked against the complete complement: M-12 viewers Harriet/Sian/Paul vs non-viewers Dev (walled) and Gwen (other client), M-11 non-viewer Paul (wall_mentions_and_links Part B, line 81; seed matters M-11/M-12 client and walled fields); (5) 'everywhere a message appears' for literal markup is covered collectively: thread, reply quote, search snippet, transcript (safe_formatting leg 2, line 191) and earlier versions (edits_and_stale_edit leg 1, line 172); (6) hold scope 'exactly that message, not its parent or its replies' checks both parent JUDGE-H0 and child JUDGE-H1C (line 155); (7) wall_every_route leg 3 'replaying ... the recorded matter-list, thread, transcript and search requests' and signin Part A 'replay each recorded request' both require every recorded route; (8) transcript_phone 'every message's text can be read' and visual transcript_page 'every message'. Unchanged guards were checked against seed timestamps for legitimate side effects: timer_changes 7-day shortening (line 139) legitimately deletes K-18 (3 May, edited to JUDGE-TE) and K-13 (4 May) and the criterion expects exactly those, while held K-7 stays and K-8 (10 May) used later by message_links/live_updates/link_highlight survives; persistence step 1 'Every item noted in step c reads exactly as it did' (line 278) only compares notes taken immediately before a restart under a fixed clock, so no legitimate retention or unread side effect intervenes; unread leg 1 exact count 2 matches posts U1,U2,U3 minus deleted U3 after M-13 was read to newest, and leg 4 is tolerant ('at least 2'); hold step 6 'Insurer letter finds nothing' and timer leg 2 'Probate/2,400/4,200 finds nothing' and 'executor' find only the intended seed rows (strings appear in no other seeded or criterion-posted message); wall_every_route leg 5 explicitly accepts either refusal or correct filing of JUDGE-W3 under its own parent; edits leg 3 tells the judge to carry the current version field so a stale-version refusal is not mistaken for authorship enforcement. Runtime: the scripted golden (hashes re-verified; golden-run.log shows all 16 functional criteria, persistence_before and the six polish checks PASS; functional.cjs:522-524 asserts the exactly-once count in thread, search and transcript and :532-537 the CAB order in both threads, search and transcript) shows these guards do not punish the reference's legitimate side effects. That is not a configured judge run on these bytes. Non-blocking observations: the 'Only a partner places or releases a hold / changes a timer' negatives use associate Sian against non-own messages only (hold_scope steps 4 and 7, timer_changes step 5); a broken app with an author exception (e.g. an author may release a hold on their own message) or a client-role hole would pass, so having Sian replay the release against her own held seeded K-17 would tighten it (P3, optional). wall_added_live leg 1 'without signing in again' is supported by 'Our staff see every matter except the ones they are walled from' and is not an unfair unchanged guard. Out of this row: sent_once Part B requires search results in C,A,B order, which rejects a newest-first search listing; the brief says order is kept 'wherever you see them', so this is defensible but worth the owner's eye under the hidden-requirement row.
